en.headline: Happy Wednesday Music and Dine Festival returns to Happy Valley tonight
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club’s themed race night at Happy Valley Racecourse features live music by PENTHAÜS, food and drinks in the Beer Garden from 6pm.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club is holding its Music and Dine Festival at Happy Valley Racecourse this evening as part of the Happy Wednesday series.

The event runs from 6pm and includes live performances, with the nine-piece band PENTHAÜS scheduled for the Beer Garden stage. Organisers have also arranged food and drink offerings paired with the music, along with stamp-collecting activities at participating stalls.

Admission to the public enclosure is HK$10, payable by Octopus at the entrance. Visitors holding valid travel documents may enter free. The Hong Kong Jockey Club said the festival combines racing with music and dining across selected November meetings, including tonight’s.
Entrants and those placing bets must be aged 18 or above. The Club organises the programme at the racecourse on Wong Nai Chung Road in Happy Valley.

zh.headline: 樂嚐星期三今晚重返跑馬地 啤酒園有現場音樂
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會跑馬地馬場主題賽馬夜今晚6時起舉行，啤酒園有PENTHAÜS現場演出及美食飲品。
body: 香港賽馬會今晚在跑馬地馬場舉辦樂嚐星期三活動，屬Happy Wednesday系列。
活動由下午6時開始，啤酒園舞台安排九人樂隊PENTHAÜS現場演出。主辦方亦準備與音樂配合的美食飲品，並設印章收集活動。
公眾席入場費為10港元，可用八達通在入口支付。持有效旅遊證件的訪港旅客可免費入場。賽馬會表示，是次節日系列在十一月選定賽馬日結合賽事、音樂及餐飲，包括今晚。
入場及投注人士須年滿18歲。活動由賽馬會在黃泥涌道跑馬地馬場舉行。
